name: Painted Tree Boutiques - Grapevine
summary: Painted Tree Boutiques in Grapevine is a unique retail collective featuring hundreds of independent vendor shops offering curated home décor, fashion, and gifts under one roof. This award-winning destination has been recognized as 'Best of the Best' since 2016, providing shoppers with one-of-a-kind treasures while supporting local entrepreneurs and artisans.
demographics: Painted Tree Boutiques in Grapevine attracts a predominantly female demographic aged 25-65, with middle to upper-middle income households seeking unique, artisan-made products and home décor. The trade area draws from the affluent Dallas-Fort Worth suburbs, particularly families and professionals who value supporting local entrepreneurs and small businesses. Shoppers typically exhibit a preference for one-of-a-kind items over mass-produced goods, with strong interest in seasonal décor, boutique fashion, handcrafted gifts, and personalized shopping experiences that emphasize community connection and discovery.
description: Painted Tree Boutiques in Grapevine offers a revolutionary shopping experience that brings together hundreds of independent shops under one roof, creating a vibrant marketplace for local entrepreneurs and artisan vendors. Since earning 'Best of the Best' recognition every year since 2016, this unique retail concept has transformed how shoppers discover curated home décor, fashion, and gifts while supporting small business owners. The boutique collective features thousands of one-of-a-kind items across carefully curated categories, from seasonal décor and furniture to clothing, shoes, jewelry, and specialty gifts. Located at 1217 West State Highway 114, the Grapevine location fosters a thriving community atmosphere where creativity flourishes through year-round events, workshops, and celebrations that connect vendors with shoppers. With friendly staff, convenient hours from 10 AM to 8 PM, and an ever-changing inventory from local creators, Painted Tree Boutiques delivers an adventure of discovery around every corner, making it a destination where shoppers can explore, discover, and adore unique treasures while supporting the local entrepreneurial ecosystem.
